reason: E4 supports the fast synthesis of homogeneous nanoalloys and their ORR relevance, but does not address CoCrFeMnNi specifically or annealing effects. E1 demonstrates diffusion-driven B2 ordering and a critical temperature in a different alloy (NbMoTa), supporting the general mechanism but not the specific CoCrFeMnNi system. E2 links B2 formation to short-range order in Al-containing HEAs, not the Al-free CoCrFeMnNi, so the premise of B2 ordering in this specific alloy is unsupported. No evidence supports the predicted 20-30% ORR activity drop.
premises: Laser synthesis produces a homogeneously disordered CoCrFeMnNi nanoalloy
Annealing above ~600°C enables diffusion-driven short-range ordering (e.g., B2-like clusters)
Short-range ordering alters local electronic structure and reduces ORR catalytic activity
B2-like ordering can occur in CoCrFeMnNi-based systems without Al
A critical temperature exists for maximum chemical ordering in complex alloys
